doctrine: Color is not decoration; hues are quarantined to meaning. A theme assigns hues TO roles; remapping preserves roles. Legibility of governance semantics survives any palette swap — that sentence is the system's reason.

layers.comment: The semantic schema has THREE layers (keeper-raised and RATIFIED 2026-08-29 ~15:00 — role/set/modifier with per-kind invariants: identity/distinctness/direction): (1) roles — closed-ish, estate-universal; (2) categorical sets — app-declared categories whose meaning is distinctness-from-siblings, not absolute semantics; (3) state modifiers — systematic transforms (highlighted/dim/...) declared once and applied to roles and set-members alike, derived by default, theme-tunable, per-token overridable.

roles.growing_by_pressure: Keeper-ruled 2026-08-29 ~14:44: 'the roles are a closed-ish set, like the language, the memory system, and the atrium. growing by pressure.' Not open accretion, not frozen — a new role must force its way in by real signal the existing six cannot carry. Adding a role is a schema change, ratified against the spec (uid above), never an ad-hoc theme-file invention.

doctrine.structure: Structure / focus — structural highlight, borders, rings, the skeleton of the surface. (April: Signal Teal.)
doctrine.info: The information channel — keys, links-at-rest, quiet data. (April: System Cyan.)
doctrine.stability: Convergence / ok / success — the system at rest and correct. (April: Convergence Green.)
doctrine.threshold: Rare and consequential — commits, gates, warnings at the edge. Threshold colors are never routine. (April: Commit Gold.)
doctrine.violation: Sacred, never decorative — integrity breach, error, the broken invariant. (April: Integrity Red.)
doctrine.intent: The human hand — invocation, ownvoice, deliberate human action. (April: Intent Magenta.)

sets.doctrine: A categorical set is an app-declared color category whose meaning is DISTINCTNESS-FROM-SIBLINGS, not absolute semantics. Sets are declared here with a namespaced name (app.set-name) and a member list. EVERY theme must map every declared set, and the member values must be pairwise distinct within that theme. Never flattened, never unmapped.

ai-usage.harness.note: The ai-usage tracker's harness lanes (kintsugi refactor, akasan spoken 2026-08-29 ~22:47): the color encodes WHICH harness a series/dot/lane-name belongs to; health state (fresh/stale/ceded) stays on the role layer, never on these.

ai-usage.series-rank.note: Keeper amendment to the ai-usage kintsugi akasan, 2026-08-29 ~22:47, verbatim: 'the extra colors are acceptable for dealing with multiple lines in a graph. however those surplus colors should still be defined in governed cognition.' A model wears its rank's color; unbounded series (including substitution rows minted mid-window by model_reported) draw from these ten declared slots. The default theme seeds its values from the tracker's proven UNIFIED_RANK_COLORS literal array — provenance, not invention.

diadem.session-type.note: The sidebar session-type dots (diadem v0.9 keeper rider): the dot's base color encodes the session TYPE; liveness stays on the pulse animation. main = the primary interactive lane, cron = scheduled/mechanical, delegated = sub-agent lanes.

modifiers.doctrine: A state modifier is a systematic transform for state variants (highlighted/not, ...). It is declared ONCE here, applied to roles and set-members alike at generate time, DERIVED by default (a lightness shift in HLS space), theme-tunable (a theme may set its own shift — light themes typically darken where dark themes lighten), and per-token overridable (a theme may pin an explicit value for one derived token). The keeper's session-type observation — 'technically 6 colors because of highlighted/not' — is 3 set-members x 1 modifier, not 6 free choices.

hi.meaning: highlighted / active / selected emphasis of the base token

surface.scrollbar_doctrine: Keeper-ruled 2026-08-29 (v0.1 browse feedback): scrollbars are quiet structure with little semantic value — they get a muted/dim value, never an accent. The odysseus-inherited amber scrollbar was a doctrine violation the governed doctrine itself rules against: color is quarantined to meaning.

color.extra: optional free-form named theme-private colors, emitted as --gc-extra-<name>; apps must not depend on an extra existing across themes

cut.note: The namrop slant grammar verbatim: clip-path polygons, keeper-tuned cut scale 28/24/18/14/12 mapped to size tiers; diagonal family for cards and bubbles, octagon for pills. Carried by the shape-slant overlay; shape is orthogonal to color — any theme x either shape, though a theme may declare a native shape. The pill tier (7px, the namrop octagon chip cut) joins the scale so pill consumers need not derive half-cuts. A mirrored diagonal template (--gc-clip-diagonal-mirror, opposite corner pair) preserves paired-surface asymmetry under slant.

shape.lift: per-theme color used when the slant overlay swaps hairline borders for background lifts (ruled)
shape.rule: slant swaps hairline borders for background lifts: under the overlay --gc-card-border goes transparent and --gc-card-lift carries the theme's lift color

invariants: Information channels are theme-tunable, NEVER theme-removable: every duration > 0, every amplitude > 0. Hush is a value, not a code path.
prefers-reduced-motion outranks every theme — the reader's own directive beats any theme's aesthetics, including the keeper's. The generator bakes the clamp into every emitted theme file.

family.alias: a family value of '@mono'/'@body'/'@display' references another family token

type.webfonts: optional per-theme list of @font-face descriptors (family/style/weight/src) — src is a relative fonts/ path vendored in this repo and copied into dist/, so it resolves both origin-served and app-vendored. LOCAL files only, no CDN ever.
